content: ECONOMICS is about how people make choices with limited resources.

- WANTS: Things you would like but don't need (toys, video games, candy)
- GOODS: Things you can touch (books, phones, food)
- SERVICES: Things people do for you (teaching, haircuts, repairs)
- When demand is high and supply is low, prices go UP
- When supply is high and demand is low, prices go DOWN
- PRODUCERS make goods or provide services
- CONSUMERS buy goods or use services

listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
ECONOMICS is about how people make choices with limited resources.
KEY CONCEPTS:
1. NEEDS vs WANTS
- NEEDS: Things you must have (food, water, shelter, clothes)
- WANTS: Things you would like but don't need (toys, video games, candy)
2. GOODS vs SERVICES
- GOODS: Things you can touch (books, phones, food)
- SERVICES: Things people do for you (teaching, haircuts, repairs)
3. SUPPLY and DEMAND
- SUPPLY: How much is available
- DEMAND: How much people want
- When demand is high and supply is low, prices go UP
- When supply is high and demand is low, prices go DOWN
4. PRODUCERS and CONSUMERS
- PRODUCERS make goods or provide services
- CONSUMERS buy goods or use services
- Most people are BOTH!
Understanding economics helps you make smart choices with money!
Economics Vocabulary:
dictation: ECONOMICS is about how people make choices with limited resources.
Understanding economics helps you make smart choices with money!
